goal: Scrape and build dataset of all digital products available in Flipkart Amazon etc — millions of products with price, categorizing, rating, seller rating etc — similar to map, big project, must complete entire Amazon and Flipkart

flipkart.free_api: https://github.com/dvishal485/flipkart-scraper-api — API does not require client id/secret, open source Rust, Docker image
flipkart.affiliate_api: https://github.com/hi-imcodeman/flipkart-scraper — requires Affiliate-Id and Token, but can scrape all products via affiliate API, 3.25k products/sec
flipkart.scraping: Python Flask API itzDM/Amazon-flipkart-scrap — scrape title, price, image, rating from URL
flipkart.free_tier: Flipkart affiliate API free tier, or scraper API Docker

amazon.scraping: Scrapy Ecommerce-Scraper ShauryaSwarup — 300 products in 15-20 sec without proxy, 30-40 sec with rotating proxy, uses ScraperAPI for rotating proxies
amazon.anti_scraping: Amazon blocks, need rotating proxies, user-agent rotation, ScraperAPI
amazon.free_tier: ScrapeOps free tier, ScraperAPI free tier 1000 req/month

phase1.name: Categories Discovery
tasks: Scrape all categories from Flipkart and Amazon
Store categories with product counts
Prioritize digital products: mobiles, laptops, electronics

phase2.name: Subcategories & Product URLs
tasks: For each category, scrape subcategories
For each subcategory, scrape product listing pages (pagination)
Collect product URLs, store in queue
Estimated: 10k listing pages, 1M product URLs

phase3.name: Product Details Massive Scrapping
tasks: For each product URL, scrape details: title, price, original price, discount, rating, seller name, seller rating, thumbnails, highlights, offers, specifications, reviews
Use proxy rotation every request, user-agent rotation, rate limit 2 req/sec per worker
4 parallel workers, 3 proxy mirrors
Store in GitHub + Vercel + IndexedDB + search-index
Classify by price ranges, rating, seller rating, category, brand
phase3.estimated: 1M products in 10 days with 4 workers (1.16 products/sec per worker)

phase4.name: Price & Rating Categorization + AI
tasks: Categorize by rating: 4.5+, 4.0+, 3.5+, <3.5
Categorize by seller rating
Use NVIDIA AI to create new sections automatically (e.g., 'Best budget mobiles under 10000 with 4.5+ rating')
Generate search-index, full-business equivalent for products

phase5.name: Full Dataset for AI
tasks: Create full-index.jsonl with all products
Create search-index.json inverted term->ids
Create api/product-ai.js for AI multi-tool to query: price, rating, seller, category, brand, search, distance not applicable but similar
Make fully indexable for AI Mode

free_storage.github: data/product-directory/cell_*.json + index.json + search-index.json + full-products.jsonl (free, versioned, 100MB per file limit, use many small files)
free_storage.search_index: Inverted index term->ids, fully indexable for AI
free_storage.note: All free, no API key for Flipkart scraper API Rust, Amazon needs rotating proxies (ScraperAPI free tier)

engineering.rate_limit: 2 req/sec per worker, rotate proxy/location every time
engineering.anti_block: User-Agent rotation, ScraperAPI rotating proxies, respect robots.txt, delay 2s between requests
engineering.ai: NVIDIA deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash for categorization, new sections auto-created
engineering.flawless: Retry with backoff, offline fallback to seed, deduplication by product id, progress persistence
